scope: Existing Fashionpedia train2020 metadata and all1000 candidate originals only; no new images, labels, splits, registry mutations, dependencies or training.

source_info.description: Fashionpedia dataset, annotated with segmentation masks and their associated per-mask fine-grained attributes

visual_inspection.observation: Runway wearer in a dark fuzzy lower garment with a visible hem; leather-like jacket is a separate upper garment. Side pose, hand and upper garment obscure part of the skirt/waist. Fur-like appearance does not identify real/faux fur or fibre composition.

Wearer in a fitted short snakeskin-patterned skirt with visible lower hem; hand overlaps the front and black top meets/covers part of waistband. Printed/reptile-like pattern and sheen do not verify leather or genuine snakeskin.

semantic_pitfalls.name: lace up
semantic_pitfalls.reason: Opening type lace up is not lace textile.

semantic_pitfalls.name: washed
semantic_pitfalls.reason: Washed finishing does not identify denim.

semantic_pitfalls.name: fair isle
semantic_pitfalls.reason: Fair isle is stored as textile pattern; this does not establish knit construction.

semantic_pitfalls.name: herringbone (pattern)
semantic_pitfalls.reason: Herringbone(pattern) is not a verified weave/fibre label.

semantic_pitfalls.name: no non-textile material
semantic_pitfalls.reason: No non-textile material does not identify a textile class or prove cotton/polyester.

singleton_overlap_policy: Material counts are image/instance annotation occurrences, not disjoint garment classes. Preserve multiple attributes; missing material labels stay missing. No annotation absence is converted to negative evidence.

recommendation: Do not train a stronger fabric model from Fashionpedia by relabelling manufacturing/pattern attributes. Only two isolated fur/snakeskin source-material examples exist, with no robust train/validation support; they do not expand the existing cotton/denim/leather/chiffon appearance pilot. A rights-compatible worn-garment source with explicit visual material annotations or linked garment-tag evidence is still needed.
limitations: No independent human fabric label confirmation or physical specimen identity established.
Two actual originals inspected visually; all1000 were hash/decode and metadata-join audited, not newly visually reviewed.
This audit uses official train metadata only; no protected final/validation seed images inspected or reassigned.
Publisher source image terms differ and are retained per original; annotation license is not a blanket image license.
Source manufacturing, pattern and material labels are distinct from fibre composition.
